candidates.description: This feature vector activates on subwords and fragments commonly found in Hindi and other Devanagari script tokens.
This vector activates for common Hindi characters, sub-word tokens, and numerals.
This vector represents numbers in the two-hundred range, including numeric tokens and their localized digit scripts.
This vector is related to Hindi consonant-vowel conjuncts featuring the vowel signs 'ू' (ū) and 'ु' (u).
This vector activates on characters, diacritics, and sub-word tokens belonging to the Devanagari script used for Indian languages.
This vector activates for characters, vowel signs, and conjuncts belonging to the Devanagari script.
This vector represents characters and letter combinations from the Devanagari script used in Indian languages.
This vector represents character tokens and subword fragments belonging to various Indic scripts, primarily Devanagari.
This vector represents common Hindi characters, vowels, and consonant clusters.
This feature vector activates on tokens containing the Hindi/Devanagari letter sequence "वर" (var) or visually and phonetically similar syllables.
